convert_visual_bert_checkpoint: convert a VisualBERT .th checkpoint to a PyTorch model saved in the output folder
run_convert_cli: run the VisualBERT checkpoint conversion script from the command line with input and output paths
load_state_dict_checkpoint: load a VisualBERT .th checkpoint file into a state dict on CPU
rename_visual_bert_keys: rename and remap VisualBERT checkpoint keys to match the HuggingFace model structure
build_visualbert_model: build a VisualBERT model for pretraining, VQA, NLVR, or multiple choice from a converted checkpoint
